findings.claim: textureLoad does not perform automatic conversion for sRGB formats
findings.evidence: Pinned wgpu-types29.0.4 texture/format.rs:101-120 states shader loads convert UnormSrgb to linear intensity. Root selected views are linear for storage-inheriting sRGB resources but can remain sRGB for sampled-only resources. The explicit conversion is gated by declared quantity format and sample_bilinear is used for both velocity and quantity.
findings.remedy: Remove the universal textureLoad claim. A behavior-descriptive sentence could say: Apply the existing explicit conversion when the quantity is declared sRGB. This alone does not resolve selected-view semantics; the Code/behavior owner must reconcile the explicit conversion with actual selected formats before clearance.
findings.owner: Canonical Advect owner with Root selected-view boundary agreement; connected Code/behavior issue
findings.acceptance: Documentation matches the agreed actual-view conversion policy. Resolve possible double conversion for sampled sRGB and global quantity flag effects on velocity; preserve intended numeric behavior explicitly, without independently changing shader math or adding tests.

contracts_checked: Storage format spelling is fallible and uses canonical color PixelFormat; unsupported formats retain actual format in StorageFormatError, with no rgba32float fallback. Native feature/usage acceptance remains provider responsibility.
TextureValue borrows canonical ResourceBaseType, checks scalar/lane projection for textures, preserves the separate general Custom-buffer path, and pads texture stores to four lanes.

CoordinateParameter admits only u32/vec2<u32>/vec3<u32>. Generated ResourceFetch retains source plus required addressing projection. LinearIndex admits population minus one; LinearPopulation admits whole population; Coordinates does not impose a flat-u32 population cap.

ResourcePipeline retains actual selected entry and declared WorkgroupShape and controlling reflected array stride or image axes. Storage record count uses logical bytes divided by native array stride, not payload size. Geometry admission is separate from actual Device and native pipeline/submission validation.

Source-cache identity includes actual Device, observation policy, source and typed recipe. Secondary resources sort named descriptors. Construction can race; no exactly-once or universal observed-success contract is established by Result::Ok.

Scan admits both authored256-wide native stages before caching and retains reflected stride. Empty input aliases input. Auxiliary records follow actual x-workgroup count; intermediate writes have live-prefix guards.

Reduce uses actual reflected stride and logical live extents, maintains Device-associated scratch, and copies a whole result stride through ranged copy; retained single/empty-buffer policy and texture rejection are distinct.

Cube shader functions derive storage spelling/native binding from effective selected format. Their native construction/recording gap remains an acknowledged required Root repair, separate from finish/submission handling.
